title: Update on Five-year Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy and Action Plan
what_it_is: Update on Five-year Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy and Action Plan

sections.label: Women and children health strategy
sections.summary: A Taskforce is finalising recommendations for a strategy on women's and children's health, preventive efforts and service delivery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The strategy will focus on supporting women and their children to attain good health and well-being, leading to a healthier next generation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: First, we are focusing on translating evidence-based findings into policies and programmes to address health risks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will also go further upstream, as early as the pre-conception phase, in implementing preventive health efforts for women and children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Second, we are reviewing service delivery for children and their families to minimise the number of touch points that our citizens need to navigate across services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Over the past year, the Taskforce, comprising members from the public, private and academic sectors, has conducted focus group discussions with parents, parents-to-be and caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have also conducted some 20 site visits and engagement sessions with frontline officers from across the health, social and education domains to better understand what matters most to children and their families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Taskforce is reviewing and finalising its recommendations for the Strategy and we will be announcing more details soon.

sections.label: Paternal and grandparent involvement
sections.summary: The answer is yes for the first question on paternal and grandparent involvement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For the first question which is paternal and grandparent involvement, the answer is yes.
